about: Source of truth for Trailhead (trailhead/index.html). Edited by Joe through Claude Code. See trailhead/README.md.
goals: Get my games out into the world on the Apple App Store.
Make something uniquely mine that others want to play.
Create a source of income that gives me the freedom to choose my jobs.
